text:
Situation: Calcium chloride 100 mg/mL 10 mL syringes are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 459 syringes (29.4 days at 15.6/day). Corvale General holds 245 syringes (16.2 days at 15.1/day). The product carries an FDA status of "To Be Discontinued" with no date provided.

Why (FDA record): The current label for NDC 00409163110 names Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) as the registered manufacturing plant. That plant was last inspected on 2025-02-07 with an NAI classification. FDA inspection records for the plant show OAI classifications in 2010 and 2011 and VAI classifications from 2009 through 2019. A Warning Letter was issued to Hospira, Inc. on 2010-04-12. The rule‑ranked alternate manufacturer ICU Medical Inc. is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly two to four weeks depending on site. No active FDA shortage listing exists, but the "To Be Discontinued" status signals future supply loss from the current labeler. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer initiates purchase agreements with ICU Medical Inc. as primary alternate; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer qualifies American Regent, Inc., Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, B. Braun Medical Inc., and Becton Dickinson and Company as secondary alternates; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer monitors daily usage at both sites and updates days-on-hand weekly; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. Buyer requests written discontinuation timeline from Hospira, Inc.; requires procurement manager approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose adjustments at this time.
